column2: kept: an exhaustive match over the expression kinds, one short arm per kind; splitting it would only scatter the arms
kept: an exhaustive match over the statement kinds, one short arm per kind
kept: one scan over the token vector with a single cursor and the two E0910 counters; every branch is a few lines of one state machine
kept: a flat list of one `let` per item form joined by one `first_of`; no branching, each form reads on its own
kept: one combinator chain for the signature and body of a function; each stage is a line of the grammar production
kept: one combinator chain for the module production of B.3; each stage is a line of the grammar
kept: one list of recovery alternatives for a module item, one `let` per form joined by one `first_of`
kept: a flat list of one `let` per pattern form joined by one `first_of`; no branching
kept: a flat list of one `let` per type form joined by one `first_of`; no branching
kept: an exhaustive match over the expression kinds, one short arm per kind
kept: one pass per table in the order the tables fill; each pass reads one arena, a split only moves the loops
kept: the stages run in the one order the resolution depends on; each stage is a call, so a split only renames the calls

kept: the rules of one probe in the order of their diagnostics (the access it names, the place, the arity, the natures of its nodes, then the role it reads); each rule is a guard and an early return, and the access lookup is already its own method

kept: a chain of early returns in the order of the rules for a method call (§3.1.7, §5.3.1, §7 rule 13); each rule is a guard and a hand-off to the method of its form, and the order is the order of the diagnostics
kept: one match over the binary operators, an arm per rule of §1.5; each arm names the operand rule of its operators

kept: one match over the expression kinds that hands the expected type to the parts of each form; the order of the guards is the order the expected type reaches them, which is the order of the diagnostics
kept: the body of `check_as`, which `Stack::deep` wraps to bound the recursion; it is the same match
kept: an exhaustive match over the expression kinds, each arm dispatching to the method of its form

kept: the steps of one `let` of a plain name in order (the annotation, a closure whose parameters wait for a call, the initializer, the bookkeeping of the binding), each reading what the one before it fixed, with an early return where one ends it

kept: the connection rules of one placement in order (the ports and their types, the arity as E0141 or E0312, then one arm per kind of port, each arm one call); the order is the order of the diagnostics

kept: the steps of one placement in the order its rules need them: the place is judged first, the placement is pushed before its arguments are typed so a feedback through it reads it, and popped after the connections; each step reads what the one before fixed, with an early return where one ends it
